candidates.name: Anthropic official Claude plugin directory
candidates.observed_distribution_model: Public GitHub plugin submitted through an authenticated form, reviewed before listing in claude-plugins-official.
candidates.preflight: Prepare a Claude plugin wrapper and pass claude plugin validate; a bare SKILL.md packet is not proof of plugin readiness.
candidates.principal_requirement: Console organization Developer, Admin or Owner; alternatively eligible claude.ai organization directory-management access.
candidates.ongoing_effect: Official documentation says published plugin updates are picked up automatically from GitHub and screened. Future updates therefore need an explicit release/authorization policy, not merely approval of initial bytes.

decision: The previous self-hosted-marketplace assessment missed the separate official directory submission route. Recommend considering that directory because it provides an observed acceptance boundary; this recommendation does not select the target or authorize submission.
required_input: Accountable owner selects registry, namespace and submitting principal, approves directory terms and the final package digest, operation, validity period and future-update policy.
claim_boundary: Research and preparation only. No registry selected, account authenticated, terms accepted, package submitted or listing accepted. Historical assessment remains preserved.
